MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40.5
   C. 81
   D. 9

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 31

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

6. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400

   C. 40
   D. 4

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 22

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

17. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

20. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

22. Solve for x: x + 6 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 12
   D. 6

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 11

24. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

25. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

26. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

27. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 20

28. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2

29. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36

30. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
